notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
